name: application-slide-over-form
title: Slide-Over Form
description: A right-edge overlay panel purpose-built for forms — a fixed header, scrollable field body, and a sticky footer with Cancel/primary actions.
useWhen: A create/edit form needs its own focused overlay without navigating away from the current page.
The form is long enough that its action buttons should stay pinned in view while the fields scroll.
avoidWhen: The overlay content isn't a form — use the plain `Sheet` or `Drawer` component for general-purpose side panels.
The form is short enough to fit in a centered modal — a `Dialog` is less disruptive to the page layout for brief forms.
responsiveBehavior: The panel is full-height and capped at max-w-sm; on narrow viewports let it grow to full width instead of overflowing.
accessibility: The panel uses role="dialog" and aria-modal="true", with aria-labelledby pointing at the visible title.
The footer's primary and secondary actions stay reachable via Tab without being scrolled out of view, since the footer is sticky/shrink-0.
The backdrop is aria-hidden and purely visual; closing on Escape or backdrop click should be wired in a real implementation.

variants.title: Invite form
variants.description: A team-invite form with name, email, role select, note, and a checkbox, in a right-edge panel with a sticky Cancel/Send invite footer.
accessibility: role="dialog" and aria-modal="true" mark the panel as a modal overlay for assistive technology.

variants.title: Invite form (Dark)
variants.description: Invite form panel adapted for dark surfaces, including form control borders and focus rings re-tuned for dark contrast.
accessibility: Form field borders, focus rings, and footer buttons all meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark panel background.
